channel.title: LC Insight
channel.description: Read the chain, not the rumors. Crypto market news and on-chain analysis.

item.title: Bitway (BTW) drops 29% in a day, now 74% below its October record
item.description: BTW fell from $1.06 to about $0.71 in 24 hours on thin volume of about $7.3 million, with Gate handling more than a third of the trading.

item.title: BlackRock's IBIT shed 22.7 million shares in four sessions as bitcoin fell to $68,393
item.description: iShares data shows IBIT's share count down 1.6% since November 6, roughly $919 million at Thursday's NAV. Bitcoin lost 7% in 24 hours.

item.title: Ether fell 14% in a week, yet 912,000 ETH is waiting in line to be staked
item.description: Ethereum's entry queue holds 3.5 times more ether than its exit queue, Validator Queue data show. SharpLink's labeled wallet staked another 128 ETH on November 12 as the price slid.

item.title: One company sold its last 211 bitcoin at $76,000. Strategy bought 1,036 at $79,012
item.description: Hyperscale Data says it has sold all its bitcoin, about 1,113 BTC since July. Strategy kept buying, but spent more than twice as much buying back its own preferred stock. Bitcoin now trades at $68,521.

item.title: Rumor vs record: Nvidia says Huang resigned but gives no reason. Was he ousted?
item.description: Nvidia announced its CEO's resignation on November 12, 2026, and crypto feeds filled with claims about why and what it did to prices. We checked six of them against Nvidia's own filing.

item.title: KPMG counted Tether Gold's bars: 520,089 ounces for 520,089 tokens
item.description: Tether says KPMG gave Tether Gold (XAU₮) a clean audit for 2025, its second Big Four audit after USDT. The gold matched the tokens almost to the ounce.

item.title: USDT shrank $2.69 billion in 8 days, but Tether's Ethereum treasury still holds $4.65 billion
item.description: Etherscan shows 4.65 billion USDT parked in the wallet it labels Tether: Treasury, which kept sending tokens out through November 12. CoinGecko counts $5.47 billion of USDT as not circulating.

item.title: Fed's Waller set a 0.3% test for a half-point hike. October's core CPI hit it
item.description: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said a 25 basis point hike in December could hurt the Fed's credibility if core inflation stayed near 0.3%. Hours later, October's core reading came in at 0.3%.

item.title: US moves to seize $1.2 billion of the Binance hack haul and shuts down North Korea's deepfake call trap
item.description: The Justice Department says it won court approval to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion stolen from Binance on October 29. It also took down servers behind "FaceStealer," a fake video call scheme it ties to more than $400 million in thefts.

item.title: 64 of 90 bitcoin treasury companies are below cost at $72,857, Strategy by $2.21 billion
item.description: At $72,857 a coin, the public companies that report what they paid for bitcoin hold $3.01 billion less than they spent, CoinGecko's treasury tracker shows. Ether holders look worse: 14 of 15 are under water.

item.title: ARB fell 8% after one wallet's $3.17 million buy. Shorts now pay on 79% of its futures bets
item.description: Sharks bought $3.65 million of Arbitrum's ARB in a day and sold $9,135, DeepSea's data show. The price kept sliding, and on most futures markets traders betting on a fall now pay those betting on a rise.

item.title: Bitcoin Core discloses 3 bugs fixed in 2025. The worst could stop a node building blocks
item.description: Bitcoin Core published three security advisories on November 10, one rated high. All were fixed in releases from October 2025, and the advisories describe no theft of coins.

item.title: U.S. bitcoin ETFs lost $1.49 billion in five straight days as bitcoin fell 9%
item.description: Spot bitcoin funds have now seen money leave on eight of the last nine trading days, $2.57 billion in all, CoinMarketCap's tally shows. Ether funds lost $477 million in the same five days.

item.title: MEET48's IDOL rose 65% and halved in under 16 hours. Futures traded 16 times spot
item.description: The small BNB Chain token jumped from $0.024 to $0.040 on Wednesday evening and was back below $0.020 by dawn. Open futures bets on it are worth more than the token's whole market value.

item.title: PEPE fell 11% in a day. Shorts now pay longs on half of its $465 million in futures bets
item.description: The frog memecoin was the worst performer among the 50 biggest coins on CoinGecko. Its open futures bets equal about a quarter of its market value, and on the biggest market, Binance's, shorts now pay longs.

item.title: PayPal's PYUSD shrank $136 million in a day and $377 million since its October 27 peak
item.description: The PayPal dollar token lost 4.9% of its market value in 24 hours, CoinGecko data show, while Ripple's RLUSD and the Global Dollar held steady. Its price never left $1.

item.title: Rumor vs record: MSCI's cut makes funds sell Strategy shares, not Strategy's bitcoin
item.description: After MSCI dropped Strategy from its USA index, posts warned of $2.8 billion to $8.8 billion in "forced selling" and asked what it means for bitcoin. We checked four claims against MSCI's own documents and Strategy's latest SEC filing.

item.title: A shark lost $4.03 million on 7 trades in a week, then bought $468,070 of a SpaceX token
item.description: A single BNB Chain wallet now accounts for more than half of the sharks' net loss on DeepSea's 7-day table. In the past day, the same address spent nearly half a million dollars on a SpaceX stock token on Arbitrum.

item.title: A shark lost $1.21 million on four chains in a week, then sold $1.36 million on Optimism
item.description: The wallet DeepSea calls Hold1f17 shows realized losses on all four chains it traded this week. In the last 24 hours it also made the largest sell-only move of any shark.

item.title: Two Avalanche wallets made 3,121 trades in a day, five times Monday's pace, and ended near even
item.description: DeepSea's shark table shows $4.86 million of bridged ether and bitcoin bought on Avalanche and $4.72 million sold. Almost all of it came from the same two wallets, swapping back and forth.

item.title: Bitcoin fell 8.5% in a week, XRP 20%, zcash 25%. Sharks did not dump bitcoin or ether
item.description: CoinGecko's 7-day numbers show the big coins sliding together. DeepSea's 24-hour shark table shows big wallets near flat on bridged bitcoin and ether, buying ARB and WLD and selling OP.

item.title: OKX and NYSE owner ICE open 24/7 tokenized stock trading on November 23, with 70+ assets
item.description: OKX says its joint venture with Intercontinental Exchange, OKXICE, starts trading tokenized US securities around the clock on November 23 under a temporary SEC exemption. OKB rose about 5% from Tuesday noon to Wednesday morning ET.

item.title: Sharks sold $3.64 million of OP in a day, $1.3 million more than they bought
item.description: DeepSea's 24-hour table puts Optimism's own token at the top of shark selling across every chain it tracks. OP is down 12.5% in a week on CoinGecko and 98% below its record.

item.title: 75 of 102 shark wallets lost money this week. One BNB Chain wallet made $967,000
item.description: DeepSea's 7-day profit table shows big traders down $2.56 million on closed trades, winning one trade in three. A single wallet made 80% of all the gains.

item.title: Deutsche Bank custody site says bitcoin, ether and 3 stablecoins are available in Germany
item.description: Germany's largest bank says its digital asset custody is available to Corporate Bank clients in Germany. Retail customers are not part of it.

item.title: Rumor vs record: will an "ANT" Anthropic stock token go live on Solana on IPO day?
item.description: A viral post says a tokenized Anthropic share called ANT will launch on Solana the day Anthropic starts trading in public. CoinGecko does list an Anthropic xStock with a Solana address, but under a different ticker, with zero supply and no price. We found no Anthropic or issuer statement that sets a date.

item.title: Stablecoins lost $13.4 billion in 30 days. USDT alone shrank $8.3 billion
item.description: CoinGecko data shows the three biggest dollar tokens all got smaller since mid-October. Tether's USDT fell every week, and November 11 was its worst day of the month.

item.title: One wallet bought $3.17 million of ARB in one trade, a day after its $3.29 million CHIP buy
item.description: DeepSea's 24-hour table shows Arbitrum sharks bought $3.65 million of ARB and sold $771. Most of it came from one wallet that Etherscan shows holding 135 million ARB.

item.title: Only 89 of 210 KOL wallets made money in 30 days. Top earner kurtz won 11 of 11
item.description: DeepSea's realized PnL table shows most tracked influencer wallets lost money over 30 days, yet the group is up $374,000 as a few big winners carried the total.

item.title: MSCI cuts Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its USA index after November 30
item.description: MSCI's November review list names "Strategy A" among 24 deletions from the MSCI USA Index. Funds that copy the index will have to sell the stock by the close of November 30.

item.title: Initia's INIT falls 71% from its day high to $0.113, below where its rally began
item.description: INIT touched $0.392 in the past 24 hours, then slid to about $0.113 by 10:05 p.m. ET on November 11. That is lower than its price before the November 9 surge, with traders swapping three times its market value in a day.

item.title: SEC cases fall to 348 from 456 as crypto examples include a $95.6 million mining fraud
item.description: The SEC's fiscal 2026 enforcement results, released November 10, show 348 actions and $1.095 billion in ordered money. The crypto cases it highlights are retail frauds, from a $14 million fake platform scheme to an FTX audit case.

item.title: 21 REX-Osprey altcoin ETFs get a new start date, November 20, after 13 months of waiting
item.description: An October 22 SEC filing pushes back the effective date for 21 planned REX-Osprey funds, from AAVE to XLM. Most of their tokens fell 15% to 38% in the past 30 days.

item.title: Midnight's NIGHT airdrop thaw ends December 4. The last 25% installments are landing now
item.description: NIGHT claimed in the Glacier Drop and Scavenger Mine unlocks in four 25% steps, and Midnight says the whole thaw ends December 4, 2026. NIGHT trades 64% below its record.

item.title: Rumor vs record: is a hacker really selling 335.9 million Binance user records?
item.description: A "pay or leak" ad offering 335.9 million Binance records, private keys included, has been reshared online. We checked each claim against Binance's own pages and a threat intelligence firm's review. Nothing confirms it, and its headline number is close to a counter anyone can read on Binance's homepage.

item.title: US prices rose 0.4% in October, with no yearly inflation rate. Bitcoin fell 1.4% on the day
item.description: October's consumer price index, out November 10, slowed from September's 0.6% jump. The Labor Department could not publish the usual 12-month rate because it collected no data in October 2025. Bitcoin dipped about 0.6% in 20 minutes around the release and ended the day near $73,650.

item.title: Grayscale's Hyperliquid ETF staked 90% of its $197 million, earning 10,341 HYPE in a quarter
item.description: The quarterly report of Grayscale Hyperliquid Staking ETF (HYPG), filed with the SEC on November 10, shows 2.22 million HYPE in the fund on September 30 and a $48.3 million quarterly gain. HYPE has since dropped about 19%.

item.title: Stablecoins shrank $1.25 billion in a day. USDT and USDC on Ethereum fell $1.06 billion
item.description: The eight biggest dollar stablecoins lost $1.25 billion in 24 hours and $4.86 billion in a week, DefiLlama data show. Ethereum and Hyperliquid shed the most, while USDC grew on Solana, Arbitrum and Base and USDT grew on Plasma.

item.title: Lighter's LIT rose 10%, and Hyperliquid holds more LIT bets than Lighter itself
item.description: LIT climbed to $3.47 while Lighter's fees held near $260,000 a day on DefiLlama. Rival Hyperliquid carries $61.4 million of open LIT bets, against $39.1 million on Lighter's own market.

item.title: Zcash fell 12% to $1,015. Hyperliquid lost 57% of its open Zcash bets in a day
item.description: ZEC dropped from about $1,160 to $1,015 in 24 hours. On Hyperliquid, open interest in the ZEC perpetual fell from $486.8 million to $211.3 million, CoinGecko data show, the steepest cut of any big venue.

item.title: A Monad shark put $3.6 million into earnAUSD, a fifth of the yield token's market value
item.description: The busiest shark on Monad bought $16 million of tokens in a day, mostly dollar tokens. Its biggest one-way bet was a yield version of AUSD that CoinGecko values at $17.7 million.

item.title: Optimism sharks lost $293,000 in a week, 20 of 24 in the red, yet bought $1.41 million of WLD
item.description: DeepSea's PnL table shows a bad week for big wallets on OP Mainnet. In the last day they bought more WLD than they sold and sold more OP than they bought.

item.title: The week's top shark made $1.52 million on 3,619 trades, then sold $369,000 of BTCB
item.description: The BNB Chain wallet that bought $5.4 million of ether three days ago leads every wallet in DeepSea's 7-day profit table. At 12:34 a.m. ET it sold 5 BTCB in one trade.

item.title: One wallet bought 5% of all circulating CHIP in a single $3.29 million trade
item.description: DeepSea logged an $18.4 million Arbitrum shark wallet buying USD.AI's CHIP token as it traded 50% below its price of a month ago. Arbiscan shows the wallet now holds 100 million CHIP.

item.title: Kinetiq's KNTQ fell 25% in a day and now trades at half its October 30 record
item.description: The token of Hyperliquid staking project Kinetiq slid from about $0.40 to $0.30 in two sharp drops on Tuesday, November 10, while HYPE and bitcoin moved less than 3%. More than half of the trading ran through Hyperliquid's own spot market, CoinGecko data shows.

item.title: Canada proposes barring banks from issuing stablecoins directly. Subsidiaries only
item.description: Budget 2026 proposes to bar federally regulated banks, trust companies and insurers from issuing stablecoins themselves. They would have to use a separate non-financial subsidiary that the Bank of Canada supervises.

item.title: BitMine bought 9,587 more ether, but its staking income estimate fell $49 million in a week
item.description: BitMine Immersion now reports 6,070,092 ETH. It staked no new coins this week, its yield estimate slipped, and ether's drop since its count has cut about $870 million off the pile's value.

item.title: Sharks bought $36.4 million of RLUSD in a day. Over the week, whales sold $12 million net
item.description: Two wallets made 37 trades in Ripple's stablecoin in 24 hours. One of them, with $97 million on DeepSea, swaps it in blocks of up to $4.5 million.

item.title: Sharks sold $19 million of gold tokens in a day, a day after buying $8.1 million of XAUt
item.description: A handful of big wallets sold $10.5 million of PAXG and $8.5 million of Tether Gold and bought back $2.8 million. Both tokens slipped about 0.9%.

item.title: 23 influencer wallets bought $555,000 of two new memecoins in a day. No priced sales
item.description: The same 23 BNB Chain KOL wallets piled into 狗狗币 and spyless within about two hours. CoinGecko does not list either token.
